title: The level is a period of translation on Gamma0 cosets
statement: Let N be a nonzero natural number, let Γ₀(N)={A∈SL₂(ℤ) : N divides A₁₀}, and let Q=SL₂(ℤ)/Γ₀(N) carry the left multiplication action. For T=((1,1),(0,1)), every q∈Q satisfies T^N·q=q.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) ⧸ CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 N), (ModularGroup.T ^ N) • q = q
